summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Currenc Group Inc. announcing the appointment of Kelly Leung as Venture Partner to advise on Web3, AI, and digital asset initiatives. No acquisition, divestiture, activism, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or forced management change is disclosed. The appointment is a routine executive hire without any special-situation event.
